# El-Bbarcs

> A free, open-source word board game that runs entirely in your browser — no backend, no signup, no tracking.

## What is El-Bbarcs?

El-Bbarcs is a browser-native word board game inspired by Scrabble and Words With Friends. It is completely free, open source (MIT license), and runs 100% client-side with no server dependencies.

Key facts:
- **Board**: 15×15 grid (same as standard word games)
- **Tiles**: 100 letter tiles with standard distribution (A=9, E=12, blanks=2, etc.)
- **Dictionary**: 359,039 English words (2-15 letters), loaded client-side via fetch()
- **Players**: 2-player hot-seat mode (pass-and-play on one device)
- **Exclusive bonuses**: Quad Word (QW) = 4× word score, Quad Letter (QL) = 4× letter score
- **Standard bonuses**: Triple Word (8 squares), Double Word (16), Triple Letter (12), Double Letter (22)
- **Bingo bonus**: +50 points for using all 7 tiles in one play
- **Blanks**: 2 blank tiles that can represent any letter
- **Tile exchange**: Swap tiles back to the bag (costs your turn)
- **Tech stack**: Pure HTML/CSS/JS in a single file, zero dependencies, no build step
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages (free, static)
- **Word list source**: [dwyl/english-words](https://github.com/dwyl/english-words) (filtered to 2-15 letters)

## How to play

1. Click a tile in your rack to select it
2. Click a cell on the board to place it
3. Build words horizontally or vertically
4. The first word must pass through the center star
5. Subsequent words must connect to existing tiles
6. Click "Play" to submit your move
7. Blanks can represent any letter — you'll be prompted to choose
8. Use all 7 tiles in one turn for a +50 bingo bonus

## Bonus squares

| Type | Count | Effect |
|------|-------|--------|
| TW (Triple Word) | 8 | 3× word score |
| QW (Quad Word) ★ | 4 | 4× word score (exclusive) |
| DW (Double Word) | 16 | 2× word score |
| TL (Triple Letter) | 12 | 3× letter value |
| QL (Quad Letter) ★ | 8 | 4× letter value (exclusive) |
| DL (Double Letter) | 22 | 2× letter value |

★ = El-Bbarcs exclusive, not found in Scrabble or Words With Friends
